title: “Moliendo café” by Hugo Blanco/Los Wawancó
text: "Moliendo Café" is a Venezuelan song that has become popular around the world. The song was written in 1958, but the authorship is disputed between Hugo Blanco and his uncle José Manzo Perroni.
